reproduces: Step one of an account signup: name, email, and Continue. The single most common form shape on the web, and the one a job-application detector has the least excuse for claiming.
reconstructed: Everything. Snake_case field names, because a signup is as likely to use them as camelCase and the gate must miss both spellings; the checkout fixture beside this one carries the camelCase half.
